chunks: Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Sulaymān ibn Khālid, who said:

I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying: “When a dead person of one of you dies, then lay him facing the qiblah. Likewise, when he is washed, a place for the washing should be dug for him facing the qiblah, such that the inner sides of his feet and his face are directed toward the qiblah.”

key_terms.بَاطِنِ قَدَمَيْهِ: the inner sides of his feet
key_terms.مَوْضِعُ الْمُغْتَسَلِ: the place prepared for washing the deceased

ai.seo_question: How should a deceased person be positioned toward the qiblah in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the handling of the deceased in Shia fiqh. It instructs that the dead person should be positioned toward the qiblah, both when laid out and during ghusl, emphasizing proper ritual orientation at death.
